goal.en: Apologize to Leo and make things right.
goal.zh: 向里歐道歉，把事情說清楚。

background: lakeside park in the late afternoon, an empty wooden bench, paper lanterns hanging in the trees, calm water, fallen maple leaves on the path, orange sunset sky

intro.en: Yesterday in class, you couldn't find your notebook. In front of everyone, you said, "Leo, you lost it!"
intro.zh: 昨天上課時，你找不到筆記本，當著全班的面說：「里歐，是你弄丟的！」

intro.en: Last night, you found it at the bottom of your own bag. Now Leo is sitting alone by the lake.
intro.zh: 昨晚，你在自己的包包底部找到了它。現在里歐一個人坐在湖邊。

lines.en: Oh... hey, Kai. Did you need something?

choices.en: Yeah. Leo, I owe you an apology.
choices.zh: 嗯。里歐，我欠你一個道歉。
choices.tip: I owe you an apology. 是鄭重道歉的開場，讓對方知道你是認真的。

choices.en: Yeah. Yesterday was nothing. Let's forget it.
choices.zh: 嗯，昨天沒什麼啦，忘了吧。

lines.en: Nothing? It wasn't nothing to me.
lines.zh: 沒什麼？對我來說可不是沒什麼。

story.en: Leo puts his headphones on and looks at the lake. The ducks look awkward too.
story.zh: 里歐戴上耳機看著湖面，連鴨子都覺得很尷尬。

fail.why: 自己犯錯時說「沒什麼啦，忘了吧」，等於否定對方的感受。先認真道歉：I owe you an apology.。

choices.en: Yeah. I feel very sorry to you.

lines.en: Sorry TO me? Wait, do you feel sorry FOR me?
lines.zh: 對我抱歉？等等，你是在同情我嗎？

story.en: Leo thinks you came to pity him. Now he feels even worse.
story.zh: 里歐以為你是來同情他的，心情更差了。

fail.why: 「對你很抱歉」不是 sorry to you；feel sorry for someone 又是「同情某人」。道歉直接說 I'm sorry. 或 I owe you an apology.。

choices.en: I found my notebook. It was in my bag.
choices.zh: 我找到筆記本了，它在我自己的包包裡。
choices.tip: 道歉時先說清楚事實，用過去式 found、was 交代發生了什麼。

choices.en: I find my notebook. It is in my bag.
choices.zh: 我找到筆記本了，它在我的包包裡。

lines.en: It's in your bag right now? So you lost it again?
lines.zh: 它現在在你包包裡？所以你又弄丟了？

story.en: Leo helps you search your bag one more time. The notebook is there. So is a very old banana.
story.zh: 里歐又陪你翻了一次包包。筆記本在裡面，還有一根很舊的香蕉。

fail.why: 找到筆記本是昨晚的事，要用過去式 found、was。用現在式聽起來像正在發生，對方會聽不懂。

choices.en: It's the blue one with a cat on it.
choices.zh: 就是那本藍色、上面有貓的。

lines.en: I know what it looks like, Kai. I helped you look for it.
lines.zh: 我知道它長什麼樣子，凱，我還幫你找過。

story.en: Leo waits for the apology. You describe the cat in great detail instead.
story.zh: 里歐在等你道歉，你卻詳細描述了那隻貓。

fail.why: 對方說 I'm listening. 是在等你說重點。道歉時先講事實（找到了、在自己包包裡），筆記本長什麼樣子跟道歉無關。

lines.en: So I didn't lose it. But you told the whole class I did.
lines.zh: 所以我根本沒弄丟。可是你跟全班說是我弄丟的。

choices.en: I know. I didn't mean to embarrass you.
choices.zh: 我知道，我不是故意要讓你難堪的。
choices.tip: I didn't mean to... 承認造成傷害，同時說明不是故意的。

choices.en: I know. I'll buy you bubble tea, OK?
choices.zh: 我知道啦，我請你喝珍奶，好不好？

lines.en: Bubble tea? That's it? You can't just buy a sorry.
lines.zh: 珍奶？就這樣？道歉不是用買的。

story.en: Leo takes the bubble tea, but he drinks it in silence. The pearls are the only thing talking.
story.zh: 里歐收下了珍奶，卻默默地喝。只有珍珠在吸管裡發出聲音。

fail.why: 在台灣常用請客表達歉意，但英語文化中先用話語承認錯誤更重要。先說 I didn't mean to embarrass you.，請客可以之後再說。

choices.en: But you lost your wallet last week!
choices.zh: 可是你上週也把錢包弄丟了啊！

lines.en: Wow. So now it's my fault?
lines.zh: 哇，所以現在變成我的錯了？

story.en: Leo walks home alone. The lanterns turn on, but nobody is there to see them.
story.zh: 里歐自己走回家了。燈籠亮了起來，卻沒有人在看。

fail.why: 道歉時翻舊帳等於替自己找藉口，對方會覺得你不是真心道歉。先承認錯誤：I didn't mean to embarrass you.。

lines.en: ...Thanks for saying that. It really hurt, you know.
lines.zh: ……謝謝你這麼說。那時候我真的很難過。

choices.en: I'll tell the class tomorrow. No hard feelings?
choices.zh: 我明天會跟全班說清楚。我們沒事了吧？
choices.tip: 說出你會怎麼彌補，再用 No hard feelings? 確認對方願意和好。

choices.en: I'll tell everyone tomorrow. You not angry anymore?
choices.zh: 我明天會跟大家說。你不生氣了吧？

lines.en: Me not angry? Are you asking me or telling me?
lines.zh: 我不生氣？你是在問我還是在命令我？

story.en: Leo isn't sure if you asked a question. He answers "Maybe?" and you both stay confused.
story.zh: 里歐不確定你是不是在問問題，只回了一句「也許吧？」，你們兩個都一頭霧水。

fail.why: 英文問句要有 be 動詞並放在主詞前面：Are you still angry?。比較自然的和好說法是 No hard feelings?。

choices.en: I'll tell the class. Don't put it on your heart, OK?
choices.zh: 我會跟全班說。你別放在心上，好嗎？

lines.en: Put it on my heart? Like a sticker?
lines.zh: 放在我的心上？像貼紙那樣嗎？

story.en: Leo draws a heart sticker on his notebook and writes "Kai's apology" on it. At least he's smiling a little.
story.zh: 里歐在筆記本上畫了一個愛心貼紙，寫著「凱的道歉」。至少他有點笑了。

fail.why: 「別放在心上」直翻成 put it on your heart 英文不通。和好時說 No hard feelings?，安慰別人說 Don't worry about it.。

lines.en: No hard feelings. But you're buying the bubble tea.
You both laugh. Above you, the lanterns in the trees begin to glow.
lines.zh: 你們都笑了。頭頂上，樹上的燈籠一盞盞亮了起來。

story.en: The next day, you tell the class the truth. Leo gets a round of applause, and you get your best friend back.
story.zh: 隔天，你跟全班說出真相。里歐得到全班的掌聲，你也找回了最好的朋友。

notes.explain: 比 Sorry 更鄭重的道歉開場，表示你知道自己錯了，而且是認真來道歉的。

example.en: I owe you an apology for yesterday.
example.zh: 昨天的事，我欠你一個道歉。

notes.en: I didn't mean to embarrass you.
notes.zh: 我不是故意讓你難堪的。
notes.explain: didn't mean to + 原形動詞，表示「不是故意的」。承認造成的傷害，同時說明你的本意。

example.en: I didn't mean to hurt your feelings.
example.zh: 我不是故意要傷你的心。

notes.explain: 道歉或爭執後用來確認對方不再介意，對方也可以回 No hard feelings. 表示和好。

example.en: Sorry about the game. No hard feelings?
example.zh: 比賽的事抱歉了，我們沒事吧？

notes.explain: 台灣人常用請客、送東西表達歉意，但英語文化中先用話語承認錯誤更重要。直接跳到請客，會像想用東西把事情帶過。

example.en: I'm really sorry. Can I buy you lunch sometime?
example.zh: 真的很抱歉。改天請你吃午餐好嗎？

notes.explain: feel sorry for someone 是「同情、可憐某人」，不是向對方道歉。道歉說 I'm sorry. 或 I apologize.。

example.en: I feel sorry for the lost puppy.
example.zh: 我很同情那隻走失的小狗。
